summary: Effingham lookout on Green Mountain: a 47-ft steel tower moved from Maine in 1922, cut to 39 ft in 1977 and re-cabbed in 2015. Cab is locked; service status is disputed.

facts.design: Steel tower with a Maine-style wooden cab set on top; new cab installed in 2015

staffing.status: disputed: part-time service per the register, no longer active per a 2025 hiking guide

access.note: Reached on foot by public trails from High Watch Road; the cab is locked.

visit.trail_note: 2.8 mi out & back, moderate, gain 1,150 ft (High Watch Trail, per a 2025 hiking guide); the platform below the locked cab gives the views

Contractors added new concrete footings, a new cab, stair treads, railings and paint; about $215,000 from state capital funds

corrections.why: 14.3 m is the original 47-ft tower. The register says the tower was shortened to 39 ft in 1977, which is 11.9 m. Whether 39 ft includes the cab is not stated.

The record's 855 ft is far below the summit the tower stands on. A 2025 guide gives the summit as 1,884 ft (574.3 m), and a 1966 item gives 1,907 ft. The Coast and Geodetic Survey note places the tower on the summit. Human check needed.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register gives 47 ft before 1977 and 39 ft after. A 1958 survey note gives about 35 ft overall, which matches neither. The story uses the register's 39 ft and says the figures disagree.
The register (undated) says part-time service. A 2025 hiking guide says no longer active. The story gives both and does not choose.

sources.title: Green Mt Fire Tower, Effingham NH

notes_for_editor: Height: the record's 14.3 m is the original 47-ft tower; the register's 39 ft (11.9 m) is proposed. The 1958 survey's 35 ft overall is unresolved. Elevation: the register's 855 ft conflicts with the 1,884-ft (2025 guide) and 1,907-ft (1966 item) summit figures; the proposed 574.3 m needs a human check. Status: the register (undated) says part-time; the 2025 guide says no longer active. Access: public trails and a locked cab per the 2025 guide; not checked with NH DRED. Staffing as of 2026 unknown. Not verified: any changes after 2025. No photos added.
